summary:
I independently reviewed the current TASK-0136 implementation against its frozen specification and normative contract, using the complete original-base-to-subject change set rather than the latest follow-up delta. The original base is 5a802cd1bb60a23d01bc0fa0a7922026176855f6, subject is b7d893f70dba6c13c0d6b9693005e69a17db03f4, and observed governance HEAD is 0e48abd4b0cb485cda0b78ed4fc8a003ad80a5dc. I built the actual implementation context with the checkout's own isolated interpreter and current production APIs. Context 27100d93e3b4182477fa9d2daf89922fc881fdf685cfbd6bc52edfc052a7c718 binds stable verification snapshot 8efff10d5d71fc9e5487b30f0b3750b7ef4cc8e069729de3c442d02ec56f9d9c, frozen spec 1ed3a60a275ebdd5c6fbd90c97742d4a24a50465709a42be535ff30c920909ae and fresh classification afb3f3b96c41337d41a8a3ccfe8bdbe6ae52ba8d8f6de26fe6c2291817d16d0f. The current normative contract, source and resource bytes match the reviewed candidate.

My direct core review covers the fixed versioned verification plans, exact Istanbul/product validators, actual installed mutation transforms and detector consumers, Node preparation/execution/output ownership, original-material replay and governance transitions. I integrated the separate independent consumer review after checking its exact report and every scoped source/schema byte against this same candidate. The consumer review covers policy/classification/initialization, evidence and version-disjoint schemas, service admission, stable implementation review and same-verifier finalization, code approval/marker recovery, Gate/freshness/status and ordinary resource packaging. No actionable finding remains in either half.

Revision 1 and native behavior remain isolated from explicit revision 2. Existing schema definitions retain their semantics, and Node CI remains rejected. The complete V1 prefix and fixed V2 checks, producer closure, original source-coordinate domain, coverage thresholds and fixed full-suite product protocol remain enforced. Detector fixtures are narrow guard tests, not execution authority. Actual installed guards, loaded origins, positive controls and designated call-phase assertions are retained. Independent copies, single-use claims, fixed isolated argv, Job/EOF/cleanup receipts, stream originals and closed inventories bind the actual executions.

For applicable fixed native-helper inputs, preparation derives the role from the bound source/material closure; actual successful node-check immediately creates the first immutable output seal. Later execution and replay compare the same complete byte/identity/membership inventory. Absent, partial, unsupported, unsafe and failed roles retain the specified rejection or diagnostic behavior. A supplied sidecar, fixture JSON or self-consistent replacement does not grant authority. The implementation uses the normative trusted-output model and does not claim independent compilation certification.

Replay preserves exact same-IMUT bindings, immutable pre evidence and append-only governance originals. Current pending-marker handling remains separate from historical interpretation. Every intervening Git commit is checked against exact registered governance roles. The actual-material entry point returns derived installed facts to the unchanged final/check/context/mutation guards; public JSON is not trusted Current. Implementation review binds the stable snapshot, while final code approval must still bind the complete final evidence. Finalization must use the original verifier and replay the same originals without another suite or mutation run.

I reviewed the companion test changes and their independently reviewed bounded follow-up, including the renamed two-branch MUT001 comparison test, meaningful negative/IO/retention/no-write cases and the scoped synthetic fixture path repair. Synthetic report, service-sequencing and stopped-transaction fixtures are explicitly distinguished from ordinary/native acceptance. Existing assertions and rejection guards are retained or strengthened; the sole Git-index test exception retains complete raw index bytes and every other snapshot role. The original base, complete changed-executable-line denominator, both coverage domains, thresholds, full-suite budget and native mutation operators are unchanged. The accompanying usage and status documentation preserves the unfinished Node CI and real-target boundaries.

I separately checked the genuinely passed current full native pre evidence, its stable snapshot, complete original log/artifact hashes, current verifier context and the real native mutation evidence loader. Current source/resource hashes are unchanged. Previously completed direct and rebuilt ordinary-installation supplemental evidence was checked within its original scope; it is not relabelled a new execution and does not substitute for this native evidence or code review. Prior failed evidence, spent actions, old reviews and raw event prefixes remain preserved.

I authored none of the implementation or companion tests. There are no open critical/high findings and no other actionable implementation findings; APPROVE applies only to the current implementation and stable snapshot bound above. This review records no spec/action/code approval, verification execution, finalization, Gate, source publication, target authority or completed integration. Same-verifier finalization, current code approval, Gate, exact-head required CI and later authorized delivery remain separate required steps.
